approximation.definition: W_lin: piecewise linear in t between the stored node doubles W_j (exact dyadic rationals), nodes t_j = j/50000; Qtilde_j := P Q_j (exact Leray projection of the stored node doubles on ktilde = (k_x, k_y, 1)); q1^N := Re(e^{iz} Qtilde_lin); U_N := (a e^{-nu t} sin y, 0, Re(e^{ix} W_lin)); a = c = d = 1, nu = 1/28, phi = 37/100 exactly
approximation.solenoidal: div q1^N = 0 exactly (P applied inside the interval computation); div U_N = 0
approximation.initial_data: Q_0 equals the exact initial coefficient (checked bitwise); W_0 exact except the n = 1 mode, whose representation error is epsW0
approximation.residual_equations: see the module docstring of validate_residual.py

arithmetic.summary: validated midpoint-radius interval arithmetic in IEEE binary64 (u = 2^-53, eta = 2^-1022, order-independent summation bound), decimal interval arithmetic for e^{-nu t_j}, cos phi, sin phi and the scalar cell integrals; every written number is an upper bound rounded up
arithmetic.summation_bound: gamma_{n-1} sum|x_i| + (n-1) eta, gamma_k = k u/(1 - k u), any evaluation order (Higham 2002, Lemma 3.1, section 4.2)

conventions.norms: torus-normalized L2; ||q||^2 = (1/2) sum_k |Qhat_k|^2 for q = Re(e^{iz} Q); ||X||_{*,3}^2 = sum_n (2+n^2)^3 |X_n|^2
conventions.int_r: upper bound of int_cell ||r|| dt, r = residual of q1^N = Re(e^{iz} Q_lin) in the full equation with base flow U_N; Galerkin part and tail
conventions.int_rW: upper bound of int_cell ||r_W||_{*,3} dt, r_W = residual of W_lin (Galerkin part and the |n| = KW+1 tail)
conventions.sup_q, sup_gradq: maxima over the coarse cell of ||q1^N||, ||grad q1^N|| (convex in tau on each fine cell)
conventions.sup_absq, sup_absgradq, sup_abshessq: maxima over the coarse cell of sum_k |Qhat_k|, sum_k |ktilde||Qhat_k|, sum_k |ktilde|^2 |Qhat_k| (bounds of sup|q1^N|, sup|grad q1^N|, sup|grad^2 q1^N|)
conventions.inflation: none: every value below is a rigorous upper bound (see arithmetic)
